title: Sawnberg
description: This is a small mod made by RedTrix Staff for a small Minecraft world.
body:
Sawnberg is a city in a small minecraft world. Each item is created for it!

**Royal Rails Items:**
- Train Ticket
- Bus Ticket
- Transport Pass

**Other Companies Items:**
- Hotel Key
- Table Key
- Poker Chips

**Ginium, Rainberg & Ginite:**
- Ginium Ore (Stone y60 to y105) Produces Raw Ginium when mined with Iron Pickaxe or higher. Then can be smelted into Ginium Ingots which can make:
  - Ginium Pickaxe
  - Ginium Nuggets
  - Ginium Key
  - Ginium Emerlad Key
 
- Rainberg Ore (Deepslate y-64 to y0) Produces Rainberg Dust when mined with Ginium Pickaxe. Then can which can be crafted into Raw Rainberg which can be smelted to make Rainberg Ingots. 
 
- Ginite Ingots can be made from 4 Ginium Ingots + 4 Rainberg Ingots + 1 Lava Bucket. Ginite Ingots can be used for:
  - Ginite Nuggets
  - Ginite Key
  - Ginite Pickaxe
